data.body: Publication-faithful rehearsal PASS. Clean rewritten-only clone at tip 9ac53960dcf46980a85c5c9e35a0dd3c60ffbda6 has 65,769 commits, 4,469 merges, size-pack 152,488 KiB, and does not contain old tip a7b89a6e7608b3e8ef65c6190c0f3cc06acd62ac. Fixed pre/post identity summaries are identical: 8,746 verified, 949 unsigned, 180 bad-signature, zero key-not-valid-at-era, 9,875 total; normalized 1,129-item (event_uuid, verdict, grandfathered) multisets are exactly equal. Isolated synthetic writer with REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_DRAIN=off advanced the disposable remote by one commit to f90fac09ad2132904901e16fd9ac2c23e1bff73d, added 124 KiB (<1 MiB), retained 4,469 merges, and old tip remains absent. A control run with drain enabled stayed on the new epoch but drained multiple pending enrichments and is rejected as a single-write size receipt; quiet-window execution must drain or disable opportunistic enrichment before the deterministic first-write measurement.
